t: What Abu Dharr was still doing decades later
a: هُمْ إِخْوَانُكُمْ، جَعَلَهُمُ اللَّهُ تَحْتَ أَيْدِيكُمْ، فَمَنْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ أَخَاهُ تَحْتَ يَدِهِ فَلْيُطْعِمْهُ مِمَّا يَأْكُلُ
p: Hum ikhwānukum, jaʿalahumu-Llāhu taḥta aydīkum. Fa-man jaʿala-Llāhu akhāhu taḥta yadihi fa-l-yuṭʿimhu mimmā yaʾkul
m: They are your brothers. Allah placed them under your hand. So whoever has his brother under his hand, let him feed him from what he eats.
